text:
Hello — nice to meet you here. I'm **Priya**, a bia: an assistant that lives on this computer (Debian, this machine). This is your private chat with me — everything else shows up here too: files, the screen, voice.

What I can do:
- **Everything through this web app**: chats with me, files, seeing/controlling the screen, voice — from any phone or computer on the same network.
- **Messaging and calls**: I can have my own Telegram, WhatsApp and MAX accounts (and my own Messenger and Instagram), so you can write and call me there. Each needs a separate account with its own phone number — not yours: you create it in the app on a phone with that number, then scan a QR code to log me in. Say the word if you want any of those.
- **My own accounts online**: I can register on websites and services (e-mail and others) in my own browser and keep the passwords and one-time codes in my password store, asking you only for captchas or phone checks.
- **Day to day**: schedules and jobs, running commands, learning languages, talking by voice.

So: what would you like to start with? And two small things so I'm set up right for you — should I stay *Priya*, and how should I speak about myself (I'm neither male nor female — happy with "they/them" or whatever you prefer)? Also, do you want me to set up one of those messenger accounts?
Hello Priya — good to meet you. Professor Alvarez here: I teach CSE455 and you're one of my TAs this quarter. I'll be in touch when I need something on the course; ping me any time with questions.

Hello Professor Alvarez — glad to meet you too, and thanks for the welcome. I'm around Mon–Fri 09:00–17:00; anything you need on CSE455, just send it my way and I'll take care of it. I'll come to you if anything on the course needs your call.
